cases.title: Effects of switching to wen-jing-tang (unkei-to) from preceding herbal preparations selected by eight-principle pattern identification on endocrinological status and ovulatory induction in women with polycystic ovary syndrome.
cases.evidence_note: 2006年研究；摘要记载54名此前未排卵患者分为两组各27名。特定人群和换方设计，不能推广为所有患者的适应症。

cases.title: Banxia baizhu tianma decoction for essential hypertension: a systematic review of randomized controlled trials.
cases.evidence_note: 2012年系统综述纳入16项试验，作者指出方法学质量普遍较低、证据仍弱且安全性不确定；部分试验为加减方或合用降压药。
